title: Duels stop dragging, and sign-in shows up
text:
If you have played the arena the last few days, you already know the problem:
fights that should end in fifteen or twenty seconds were stretching on and on.
Today's build tracks down why and fixes it for good.

title: Duels stop dragging, and sign-in shows up
text:
